access_scope.authentication: NONE; public GitHub release-metadata route; no provider key, signup, login, wallet, subscription or trial
access_scope.collection_scope: One metadata inspection only; stop on redirect, non-200, oversize or transport failure. Count the attempted GET even when it fails.

known_limitations: The retained October 21 README lists player boxscores through season 2026, while schedules/rosters reach 2027; current final-player coverage remains UNKNOWN.
Publisher asset upload time is not an upstream observation clock or proof that a target game is final.
Existing nba_data.normalize_sdv_row and with_sdv_schedule provide offline reusable semantics; the current daily final CSV normalizer remains development-only.
An eventual statistical correction appends new source evidence, a linked outcome revision and revised statistical grades; no venue financial-finality assumption is supplied here.
not_admitted: Downloading any player-boxscore asset before the actual metadata result is reviewed
Current season-2027 player coverage or a guessed player_box_2027 filename
Finality, participation, row completeness, statistic semantics or correction behavior of an uninspected asset
Direct ESPN extraction or blanket upstream rights clearance
Any genuine outcome import, statistical grading, activation, scheduling, merge or deployment
payload.purpose: Identify actual publisher-advertised NBA player-boxscore assets before proposing any final-outcome capture or grading admission.
payload.recurring_scope: The broader owner goal authorizes preparing a later permitted daily forecast/grading path. The exact final-source family, actual assets, bounded retention and operational policy still require verification before that route can operate; this one-inspection receipt neither installs nor activates recurring collection.

exact_excerpts.text:
This repository is the **release store** of the
[SportsDataverse](https://sportsdataverse.org): the `load_*()` functions
in the SportsDataverse R packages and in `sportsdataverse-py` read their
data from the GitHub releases published here (the nflverse-parity NFL
loaders read the nflverse-data releases instead). This page shows how

exact_excerpts.meaning: NBA player-boxscore family and retained through-season

source_use_basis.assessment: The retained publisher README identifies this repository as its data-release store, displays a CC BY 4.0 label, and explicitly lists the NBA player-boxscore release. This supports bounded inspection and retention of this public publisher release metadata with attribution; it is not an inference from HTTP accessibility or a scraper software license.
source_use_basis.attribution: SportsDataverse sportsdataverse-data NBA player-boxscore release metadata, ESPN-derived via hoopR; CC BY 4.0.
source_use_basis.lineage: ESPN-derived via hoopR-nba-raw and hoopR-nba-data, published by SportsDataverse.
source_use_basis.modification_notice: Nick’s Multisport Lab selects and summarizes release metadata. Exact original metadata bytes and publisher provenance are retained; summaries do not imply endorsement.
source_use_basis.publication: Source-review metadata and attributed excerpts only. No final-player outcome, forecast, offer or ticket publication is admitted by this receipt.
source_use_basis.retention: Retain the exact bounded metadata response, its actual observation clocks, bytes/hash and request result in this existing repository with attribution. Preserve prior evidence unchanged.
